questions.q: 20 cm³ of hydrogen is exploded with 20 cm³ of oxygen. 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O. What gas remains at r.t.p.?
questions.why: 20 cm³ H₂ needs only 10 cm³ O₂, so hydrogen is limiting and 10 cm³ O₂ is left over.

options: a substance chemically combined with water
a substance that absorbs water from the air
questions.why: This is the syllabus definition; anhydrous means containing no water.

questions.q: 2.8 g of iron is heated with 2.0 g of sulfur. Fe + S → FeS. What mass of FeS forms? (Ar: Fe = 56, S = 32)
questions.why: n(Fe) = 0.050, n(S) = 0.0625, so iron is limiting: 0.050 × 88 = 4.4 g.

questions.q: 4.8 g of magnesium is added to 0.30 mol of hydrochloric acid. Mg + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + H₂. Identify the limiting reactant and calculate the volume of hydrogen at r.t.p. (Ar Mg = 24)
questions.model: n(Mg) = 4.8 ÷ 24 = 0.20 mol, which needs 0.40 mol HCl; only 0.30 mol, so HCl is limiting. n(H₂) = 0.30 ÷ 2 = 0.15 mol; V = 0.15 × 24 = 3.6 dm³
